title: Update delegation messaging docs for durable mailbox contracts
outcome: The delegation feature document still shows the removed two-argument termal_send_to_session contract and old delivery receipt, omits mailbox read/ack tools, and does not describe the required idempotency key or child restrictions.
acceptance: The delegation and mailbox feature documents describe the current durable mailbox contract, contain reciprocal links, list all root peer/mailbox tools and child restrictions, and contain no executable examples using the obsolete contract.
